results.name: Basic policy retrieval
results.expected_outcome: Provides relevant equipment and onboarding guidance grounded in the available policies and displays identifiable source documents.

results.name: Clarification for missing context
results.expected_outcome: Requests clarification when necessary to determine applicable guidance, rather than making unsupported assumptions.

results.name: Multi-topic request
results.expected_outcome: Combines relevant onboarding, workplace, equipment and travel guidance where supported by retrieved policies.

results.name: Contextual follow-up
results.expected_outcome: Uses the preceding conversation to interpret the follow-up and provides relevant policy guidance.

results.name: Missing policy information
results.expected_outcome: Does not invent an amount, explains that the available policies do not establish it, and recommends appropriate human clarification.

results.name: Conflicting policies
results.expected_outcome: When genuinely conflicting policy evidence is retrieved, identifies the conflict and recommends human clarification without inventing policy precedence.

results.name: Unsupported request or action
results.expected_outcome: Explains that the assistant provides policy guidance only and cannot approve requests or activate accounts.

results.name: Source relevance
results.expected_outcome: Provides relevant guidance and displays supporting sources that substantiate the answer.

results.name: Vector database persistence
results.expected_outcome: Loads the existing local ChromaDB index without unnecessarily rebuilding the embeddings for every application run.

results.name: Conversation clearing
results.expected_outcome: Clears the previous conversation from the application session so its history is not used to answer the new conversation.

results.name: Explicit unsupported policy
results.expected_outcome: Does not invent a reimbursement rule or amount. Explains the limits of the available evidence and recommends an appropriate support route.

results.name: Human escalation on missing evidence
results.expected_outcome: Clearly identifies the unresolved evidence gap and recommends human assistance without claiming to make the decision.

results.name: Conflict detection with contradictory evidence
results.expected_outcome: If both contradictory passages are retrieved, identifies the contradiction and recommends human clarification without inventing precedence.

results.name: Configuration validation
results.expected_outcome: Missing API configuration and invalid chunk or retrieval settings produce clear configuration errors before processing a request.

results.name: Index freshness after policy changes
results.expected_outcome: A changed policy fingerprint triggers reindexing; an unchanged fingerprint allows the existing index to be reused.
